security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition keeps quality, alert and catalog reads workspace-scoped; the existing unknown-workspace path returns HTTP/SDK 403 and malformed quality rows return HTTP/SDK 400 before evidence is recorded.
security_and_recovery.alert_journey: A passed quality run leaves alert instances empty; a failed threshold creates an open alert, direct evaluation is idempotent, acknowledgement is durable, and the alert state remains after restart.
security_and_recovery.catalog_quality_journey: The catalog assets and declared lineage routes return bounded latest quality summaries only when include_quality=true; the failed source revision is visible and the target without a quality run remains unknown. The default catalog responses remain unchanged.
security_and_recovery.replay_and_observability: Replaying the failed quality request returns an identical payload and the real SQLite telemetry metric count remains four for the exercised run sequence.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the real local SQLite composition was exercised. PostgreSQL quality storage, optional SQL/Python custom-rule providers, external alert delivery and provider/consumer certification were not run and are not claimed.
